description: This file defines a report parser class for generating invoice layout reports in Odoo (formerly OpenERP), including methods for processing invoice lines and formatting report data.

classes.name: account_invoice_1
classes.description: Report parser class for invoice layout, extending report_sxw.rml_parse, with methods to generate invoice line data for reports.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with time and invoice_lines method.

methods.name: invoice_lines
methods.description: Generates a list of invoice line dictionaries with formatted data for report rendering, including tax info, quantities, prices, and notes.
